QuestInfo.name: [Arcana] Wock Spiwit Wescue
QuestInfo.0: Perhaps the Rock Spirit knows what is blocking the flow of water? Speak with it.
QuestInfo.1:
It seems the Rock Spirits are stuck between a root and a hard place.  Freeing them should un-stop the lagoon, but they are too high to be reached. Rescue the Rock Spirits scattered throughout the cavern in exchange for their help.

(You can save the #rRock Spirit#k by getting close and using #bInteract/Harvest#k.)
QuestInfo.2: You rescued all the Rock Spirits scattered throughout the cave.
